title: Rams revel in Aaron Donald's comeback, but he might not suit up for opener

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Rams revel in Aaron Donald's comeback, but he might not suit up for opener
sources.description: Rams players, including Quentin Lake and Kobie Turner, are thrilled Aaron Donald is back on the team, but Sean McVay won't push for him to play in the opener.
